title: Drill vs. Deadline
hook_reason: We land in the middle of the drilling with Marcus already flinching, and the line names the annoyance. There is no product claim and no warm-up.
plan: s01 5 words = 4 s; s02 3 words = 4 s; s03 5 words = 4 s; total 12 s

shots.framing: Marcus at the desk, laptop in front of him, earbud case resting beside the laptop, dark wall behind
shots.speaker: voiceover
shots.first_frame: Marcus sits at the dark matte desk with shoulders hunched, hands flat either side of the open laptop. The graphite Noctave Air case rests closed on the desk next to a ceramic mug and a notepad. His eyes are on the screen.

beats.action: Marcus flinches and presses one palm against his ear as the drilling sound starts
beats.eye_line: looks down at the laptop screen

beats.action: Marcus lowers his hand and picks up the earbud case from the desk
beats.eye_line: looks at the case in his hand

shots.setting: dark matte desk top, open laptop with icy blue glow, ceramic mug, notepad, closed graphite earbud case, plain dark wall
shots.lighting: single LED key light with small softbox, camera-left at desk height, hard-edged key
shots.delivery: flat and dry, low, a short pause before 'through the wall'
shots.audio_notes: loud power drill through the wall over faint apartment room tone, laptop fan hum

shots.framing: Marcus's face and shoulders, one earbud in his ear, laptop glow on his glasses
shots.speaker: marcus
shots.first_frame: Marcus sits at the desk with a graphite Noctave Air earbud in his right ear and his fingertip resting on it. His shoulders are still slightly raised and the laptop glow shows on his glasses.

beats.action: Marcus taps the earbud once with his fingertip, then lowers his hand to the keyboard
Marcus lets out a long breath, shoulders dropping, and starts typing
